name: date-picker
description: Compact DatePicker, closed range, presets Menu.
docs: `DatePicker` `.compact` + `ClosedRange<Date>` restricts pickable dates. `Menu` presets write binding. `calendar`: graphical month view. Compact = single tap target; no wrapper. Empty/reversed range traps at one date.
accessibility: DatePicker: title = accessibility label; reads date.
Label presets Menu; clear without visible glyph.
